steps.line: * Then every menu bar item except separators shows in the accessibility tree with its title and a press action

expect.that: def titles: (if (.path | type) == "array" then .path | map(. // "") else .path // "" | sub("^>"; " >") | sub(" >$"; " > ") | split(" > ") end) | if . == [] then [""] else . end; def blank: test("\\S") | not; def separator: (titles | last | blank) and .key == "-" and (.enabled == false or .enabled == "disabled"); [.menus.items[] | select(separator | not)] | length > 0
expect.why: the menu bar's items show in the accessibility tree at all

expect.that: def titles: (if (.path | type) == "array" then .path | map(. // "") else .path // "" | sub("^>"; " >") | sub(" >$"; " > ") | split(" > ") end) | if . == [] then [""] else . end; def blank: test("\\S") | not; def separator: (titles | last | blank) and .key == "-" and (.enabled == false or .enabled == "disabled"); [.menus.items[] | select(separator | not) | titles | all(blank | not)] | all
expect.why: every item but a separator shows with its title, as does every menu on its path; enabled is read with palantir in front, so only items disabled there count as separators

expect.that: def titles: (if (.path | type) == "array" then .path | map(. // "") else .path // "" | sub("^>"; " >") | sub(" >$"; " > ") | split(" > ") end) | if . == [] then [""] else . end; def blank: test("\\S") | not; def separator: (titles | last | blank) and .key == "-" and (.enabled == false or .enabled == "disabled"); [.menus.items[] | select(separator | not) | .press == true or .press == "press"] | all
expect.why: every item but a separator shows with a press action
